    SurfaceArea(b: Box3D): Number
        => 2.0 * (b.Size.Width * b.Size.Height
            + b.Size.Width * b.Size.Depth
            + b.Size.Height * b.Size.Depth);

    // Steiner's parallel-body surface area (see the section note).
    SurfaceArea(b: RoundedBox3D): Number
    {
        var r = b.EffectiveCornerRadius;
        var e = b.CoreExtents;
        return 2.0 * (e.X * e.Y + e.X * e.Z + e.Y * e.Z)
            + 2.0 * Number.Pi * r * (e.X + e.Y + e.Z)
            + 4.0 * Number.Pi * r.Square;
    }
```

    // The cylindrical lateral surface 2*pi*r*L plus the two hemispheres, which
    // together make one whole sphere 4*pi*r^2. There are no flat caps.
    SurfaceArea(c: Capsule3D): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi * c.Radius * c.SpineLength + 4.0 * Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square;
```

    // Both lateral surfaces 2*pi*h*(R + r) plus the two annular caps
    // 2*pi*(R^2 - r^2). The inner wall is part of the solid's boundary.
    SurfaceArea(s: CylindricalShell): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi * s.Height * (s.OuterRadius + s.InnerRadius)
        + 2.0 * Number.Pi * (s.OuterRadius.Square - s.InnerRadius.Square);

    SurfaceArea(t: Tetrahedron): Number
        => Triangle3D(t.A, t.B, t.C).Area
        + Triangle3D(t.A, t.B, t.D).Area
        + Triangle3D(t.A, t.C, t.D).Area
        + Triangle3D(t.B, t.C, t.D).Area;

    // The two triangular ends plus one parallelogram per base edge, each of area
    // |edge x Offset|.
    SurfaceArea(w: Wedge): Number
        => 2.0 * w.Base.Area
        + w.Base.A.Between(w.Base.B).Cross(w.Offset).Magnitude
        + w.Base.B.Between(w.Base.C).Cross(w.Offset).Magnitude
        + w.Base.C.Between(w.Base.A).Cross(w.Offset).Magnitude;
```

    SurfaceArea(s: SphericalShell): Number
        => 4.0 * Number.Pi * (s.OuterRadius.Square + s.InnerRadius.Square);

    // The curved cap 2*pi*R*h PLUS the flat cutting disk pi*a^2, because the solid

    SurfaceArea(c: SphericalCap): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi * c.Sphere.Radius * c.CapHeight
        + Number.Pi * c.CapBaseRadius.Square;

    // APPROXIMATE. The surface area of a general ellipsoid is an incomplete
    // elliptic integral with no elementary closed form; this is KNUD THOMSEN'S
    // FORMULA,
    //     S ~= 4 pi ( ((ab)^p + (ac)^p + (bc)^p) / 3 ) ^ (1/p),   p = 1.6075,
    // whose relative error is at most 1.061% over ALL semi-axis ratios and is zero
    // for a sphere. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellipsoid#Approximate_formula
    SurfaceArea(e: Ellipsoid): Number
    {
        var p = 1.6075;
        var ab = (e.SemiAxes.X * e.SemiAxes.Y).Pow(p);
        var ac = (e.SemiAxes.X * e.SemiAxes.Z).Pow(p);
        var bc = (e.SemiAxes.Y * e.SemiAxes.Z).Pow(p);
        return 4.0 * Number.Pi * ((ab + ac + bc) / 3.0).Pow(1.0 / p);
    }
```

    // 4 * pi^2 * R * r — Pappus's theorem applied to the minor circle. Ring torus

    SurfaceArea(t: Torus): Number
        => 4.0 * Number.Pi.Square * t.MajorRadius * t.MinorRadius;
